messages:
Jenna: Morning team — running an integrator shadow day next Wed (Apr 8). Need a short checklist for labs/hw access, trainer dry-run, and joint announcement timing. Who can own what?
Priya: I can own badges & lab access (perm lists, AD groups, equipment signout). Will need attendee emails by Monday.
Diego: I'll own the SI curriculum + hands-on exercises. Also validate runtime on our two partner racks (A100 cluster + Trident board).
Alex: I can handle VPC/VPN onboarding docs and ephemeral creds for the demo VPC. Will need a list of test IPs.
Sam: DevEx will create a 20-min quickstart + invite templates and an onboarding checklist that fits the shadow day.
Mia: Training will update the cert path for the orientation cohort. Thinking: 2hr lab + 30min proctored practical — pass = 80%.
Jenna: Perfect. For hardware partners we need rack allocation, power/cable check, drivers preloaded, and a person on-site to swap units if needed. @Diego can you confirm driver/quant profiles?
Diego: Yes. I'll run a smoke-test matrix and share quantization profiles. Need to pin model to v1.3 for the demo. Also adding a short KV/prefix cache test.
Diego: Smoke test command (local):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TEST_KEY" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-demo-1.3","input":"perf smoke test - sequence=64"}'
```
Priya: Badge process: create AD group name "SI-shadow-2026" and give it access to lab-doors + floor-3 rack. I'll collect emails — pls DM me attendee list.
Alex: VPN quick steps: https://go.redwood/vpn-onboard — provision VPN certs, then request ephemeral keys. For Private demo, ensure KMS key is accessible to demo role (no permanent KMS export).
Sam: For the quickstart I'll include: 1) API key basics 2) minimal runbook for swapping model variants 3) troubleshooting tips (OOM, latency spikes).
Mia: Certification logistics: need proctors + proctoring playbook. @Priya can you confirm room booking and keyboard access?
Priya: Room booked (Lab B, 9am–1pm). Keyboard / dongles on the reserved cart. I'll sync with facilities for power strip + UPS check.
Jenna: Marketing note — they want a 48h lead for any joint announcement and a signed partner quote. Can partnerships deliver go/no-go by Tue EOD?
Diego: We need a dry-run for trainers — propose Mon 11am to validate flows. If that passes, can confirm.
Sam: I'll schedule calendar invites for trainer dry-run + shadow day.
onboard-bot: Task created: 1769890001 — "SI shadow day checklist" assigned to Priya. Link: https://tasks.redwood/1769890001
Priya: Got it. I'll post a living checklist doc in #partnerships by EOD with action items and owners.
Jenna: Awesome — final asks: 1) trainer dry-run Mon 11am, 2) attendee emails to Priya by Mon 9am, 3) devex quickstart ready Tue noon, 4) marketing go/no-go Tue EOD. Can everyone ack?
Diego: Ack :thumbsup:
Alex: Ack
Sam: Ack
Mia: Ack
Priya: Ack — will follow up with the checklist link
Jenna: Thanks team — keeping this tight makes the joint announcement possible. I'll follow up with partner ops to confirm the signed quote.
